intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market shows subdued price pressure with turnover-weighted breadth slightly positive and median momentum flat. Liquidity is heterogeneous, with elevated spread dispersion and a high share of stale quotes, while the deepest venues show tight microstructure on select high-turnover names. Recent deterministic policy shifts have introduced a mild risk-off tilt via patch-window controls.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and rotationally active; investors are favoring quality, depth, and carry over speculative breadth.
intelligence.regime: Low-volatility, range-bound rotation with policy-mediated risk-off microstructure.
intelligence.research_summary: Deterministic controls and patch-window risk parameters are the dominant short-term drivers. OFFICIAL updates dominate the event space, while COMMUNITY signals (e.g., Cyclops head, Steel kiteshield) provide secondary context. Model_inference highlights carry and edge in top candidates, with Frontier adding shock/catalyst overlays.
intelligence.summary: Breadth is marginally positive but momentum is flat and dispersion high. Turnover-weighted pressure is slightly negative, liquidity is uneven, and the patch window is constraining risk appetite. The economy is in a controlled, rotation-driven regime rather than a momentum or speculative surge.

assumptions: Read-only replay; never touches live wallet state.
Uses 1-hour Wiki bars, so 5-minute flow is approximated from hourly volume and trailing activity.
Passive fills remain the deterministic expected-fill model used by the paper engine; this is diagnostic, not a claim about real GE queue fills.
The LLM semantic prior is disabled in replay so strategy diagnostics remain deterministic and reproducible.
The usual weekly update-window prior is evaluated at each historical replay timestamp rather than using the current live clock.
Universe is bounded to currently relevant/high-activity items, so results are a strategy diagnostic rather than an exhaustive historical backtest.
